title: After decades out of mind, 'French Woodstock' resurfaces thanks to newfound footage
subhed: Fifty years after the Riviera 76 festival held its first and only edition in southern France, with a lineup that notably included Joe Cocker, Betty Davis and Magma, the National Audiovisual Institute has brought it back to life. A new televised documentary features restored footage from reels found in a cellar.
